title: There is/are - Extended uses and contexts

options.answer: There is many books on the shelf.
There are a new student in the class.
There are some apples in the basket.

explanation.en: The phrase 'there are' is used with plural nouns, such as 'apples'. 'There is' is for singular nouns.
explanation.ru: Фраза 'there are' используется с существительными во множественном числе, например, 'apples'. 'There is' — для единственного числа.
explanation.uz: 'There are' iborasi ko'plikdagi otlar bilan, masalan, 'apples' bilan ishlatiladi. 'There is' esa birlikdagi otlar uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: There is any problems with the new system.
Is there a good reason for this?
Are there a big dog in the park?

explanation.en: In questions, the verb 'is' comes before 'there' for singular nouns, and 'are' comes before 'there' for plural nouns.
explanation.ru: В вопросах глагол 'is' ставится перед 'there' для существительных в единственном числе, а 'are' — для множественного.
explanation.uz: Savollarda 'is' fe'li birlikdagi otlardan oldin, 'are' esa ko'plikdagi otlardan oldin ishlatiladi.

options.answer: There is a lot of information on the internet.
There are a lot of information on the internet.
Are there a lot of information on the internet?

explanation.en: The noun 'information' is an uncountable noun, which requires the singular verb 'is' with 'there is'.
explanation.ru: Слово 'information' — это неисчисляемое существительное, которое требует глагола 'is' в единственном числе после 'there is'.
explanation.uz: 'Information' so'zi sanalmaydigan ot bo'lib, 'there is' iborasidan keyin birlik fe'lini talab qiladi.

options.answer: There were a lot of people at the party.
There was a lot of people at the party.
There are a lot of people at the party, yesterday.

explanation.en: In the past tense, 'there were' is used with plural nouns like 'people'. 'There was' is for singular nouns.
explanation.ru: В прошедшем времени 'there were' используется с существительными во множественном числе, такими как 'people'. 'There was' — для единственного числа.
explanation.uz: O'tgan zamonda 'there were' ko'plikdagi otlar, masalan, 'people' bilan ishlatiladi. 'There was' birlikdagi otlar uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: There is no milk left in the fridge.
There are no milk left in the fridge.
There have no milk left in the fridge.

explanation.en: The noun 'milk' is uncountable, so it requires the singular form 'there is'. The word 'no' is used to create a negative statement.
explanation.ru: Существительное 'milk' — неисчисляемое, поэтому оно требует единственной формы 'there is'. Слово 'no' используется для создания отрицательного утверждения.
explanation.uz: 'Milk' so'zi sanalmaydigan ot bo'lgani uchun 'there is'ning birlik shaklini talab qiladi. 'No' so'zi inkor gapni hosil qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Is there some money on the table?
Are there some money on the table?
Is there any money on the table?

explanation.en: The noun 'money' is uncountable, so 'is there' is used for a question. 'Any' is the correct word for a question about quantity.
explanation.ru: Существительное 'money' — неисчисляемое, поэтому для вопроса используется 'is there'. 'Any' — правильное слово для вопроса о количестве.
explanation.uz: 'Money' so'zi sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun savolda 'is there' ishlatiladi. 'Any' miqdor haqidagi savolda to'g'ri so'z hisoblanadi.

options.answer: There seems to be an issue.
There seem to be an issue.
There are seem to be an issue.

explanation.en: The verb 'seems' agrees with the singular noun phrase 'an issue' that follows 'to be'.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'seems' согласуется с существительным в единственном числе 'an issue', которое следует за 'to be'.
explanation.uz: 'Seems' fe'li 'to be'dan keyin keluvchi 'an issue' birlik ot so'zi bilan mos keladi.

options.answer: There's a lot of things to do.
There's a lot of work to do.
There are a lot of work to do.

explanation.en: The contraction 'There's' is used with the uncountable noun 'work'. The plural noun 'things' would require 'There are'.
explanation.ru: Сокращение 'There's' используется с неисчисляемым существительным 'work'. Множественное число 'things' потребовало бы 'There are'.
explanation.uz: 'There's' qisqartmasi 'work' sanalmaydigan oti bilan ishlatiladi. 'Things' ko'plik ot uchun esa 'There are' talab qilinadi.

options.answer: There must be a mistake in the calculations.
There must are a mistake in the calculations.
There must be many mistake in the calculations.

explanation.en: The modal verb 'must' is followed by the base form of the verb 'be'. 'A mistake' is a singular noun.
explanation.ru: Модальный глагол 'must' следует за основной формой глагола 'be'. 'A mistake' — существительное в единственном числе.
explanation.uz: 'Must' modal fe'lidan keyin 'be' fe'lining asosiy shakli keladi. 'A mistake' esa birlik otidir.

options.answer: There is a dog and two cats in the garden.
There am a dog and two cats in the garden.
There is a dog and there are two cats in the garden.

explanation.en: When listing a singular and plural noun, you can use 'there is' for the singular noun and 'there are' for the plural noun.
explanation.ru: При перечислении существительного в единственном числе и во множественном числе можно использовать 'there is' для единственного и 'there are' для множественного.
explanation.uz: Birlikdagi va ko'plikdagi otlarni sanab o'tganda, birlik ot uchun 'there is' va ko'plik ot uchun 'there are' ishlatish mumkin.
